Frazz is a goblin tending to the rockets at the Gala of Gifts in Durotar during Love is in the Air.
__NOTOC__ Frail Skeletons are guardian skeletons summoned by Scholomance Dark Summoners in Scholomance. As the name suggests, they are very weak.

Fowl Beasts are ducks located at Winterpelt Hollow in the Azure Span.

Fractured Causality is a sandstorm elemental boss in the alternate worlds visited during Time Rifts. When approached by Soridormi and adventurers, it takes the form of a leader in that world. After the leader is defeated, it reverts back to its elemental form.

Frayed Legacy is an optional breadcrumb to the optional Spores of Dread chapter of the Isle of Dorn storyline. This breadcrumb starts in Freywold Village, but the next quest, Mycomayhem, can be picked up at Boskroot Basin without any prerequisites.
The Fractures in Time Launch Trailer is the official trailer for Patch 10.1.5: Fractures in Time.
Fragments of Shadow are voidwalkers located in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible.
Frame of Felled Insurgents drops from Queen Ansurek in Nerub-ar Palace.
Fragrant Plant is located on the shore of the north-western coast of the Waking Shores. It is involved in the Azure Frillfish treasure, and interacting with it applies .
__NOTOC__ Fragrant Stonelamb are mosswools found throughout the Isle of Dorn.
Fourman Grimes is a kobold located in Gundargaz in the Ringing Deeps.
Frayed Aranasi Silk can occasionally be found in Otherworldly Treasure.

Fragment of an Ancient Statue drops from the Ancient Statue at the Broken Pillar in Tanaris.
Frankle's Energy Extractor is located next to Boatwright Frankle at the Blackwater Marina in the Undermine.

Fractured Spark of Omens is rewarded from weekly Khaz Algar caches and has a chance to drop from bosses inside Nerub-ar Palace. It can also be purchased from Ardgaz in Dornogal for 6x Algari Token of Merit. Combine two fractured sparks and 250 Valorstones to make a Spark of Omens, used to craft Champion-track gear. Use this command to check how many Fractured sparks have been acquired: /run a=C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyInfo(3023) print("You have earned",a.quantity,"of",a.maxQuantity,"possible Fractured Spark of Fortunes")

Fractured Spark of Fortunes is rewarded from weekly Khaz Algar caches and has a chance to drop from bosses inside Liberation of Undermine. It can also be purchased from Ardgaz in Dornogal for 6x Algari Token of Merit. Combine two fractured sparks with 250 Valorstones to form a Spark of Fortunes, used to craft Champion-track level gear. Use this command to check how many Fractured sparks have been acquired: /run a=C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyInfo(3132) print("You have earned",a.quantity,"of",a.maxQuantity,"possible Fractured Spark of Fortunes")
Fractured Interface Crystals can be looted from Etched Machine Speaker's Reliquaries and Machine Speaker's Reliquaries in the Ringing Deeps.

Fractals? For Spring? Groundbreaking. is a collections achievement earned by collecting an armor set from the Manaforge Omega.
Fractillus' Last Breath drops from Fractillus in Manaforge Omega.

Fragrant Dreaming Glory are a special version of the normal Dreaming Glory looted from the objects of the same name in Telaari Basin in Nagrand in Outland. Hemet Nesingwary wants them for Comfort Stones and More Cozy Beds, part of the Otherworldly Ecologist storyline for Ecological Succession.

Fractured Spark of Starlight is rewarded from weekly Khaz Algar caches and has a chance to drop from bosses inside Manaforge Omega. It can also be purchased from Ardgaz in Dornogal for 6x Algari Token of Merit. Combine two fractured sparks with 250 Valorstones to form a Spark of Starlight, used to craft Champion-track level gear. After obtaining the first, Spark of Starlight (quest) will start. Use this command to check how many Fractured sparks have been acquired: /run a=C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyInfo(3141) print("You have earned",a.quantity,"of",a.maxQuantity,"possible Fractured Spark of Fortunes")

Foxton's Song is an orcish lok'vadnod composed by Thrall in honor of his late childhood friend, Taretha Foxton. She is the only known human to have ever had a lok'vadnod sung of her life. The song describes Thrall forging one or a set of axes, also named "Foxton's Song", in her memory.

Free For All (FFA), alternatively Player vs. All (PvA), is when you can fight any player of any faction including your own. However, it is closer to Group (Party or Raid) versus All, since group members are considered allies and will not receive damage from you and will receive your heals and buffs.

Freightrunner's Flask drops from Zaen Bladesorrow in Murder Row.

Frix Xizzix is goblin found atop one of the stone spires in the Lower Wilds of . He can only be reached via getting knocked off of Wirdal Wondergear's pillar by the gnome's Tower Defense Automatons. Paladins can heal him in order to get the Rune of Grace (paladin). He and his siblings came from the Lost Isles looking to start up a new business venture but they ran afoul of some pirates who stole their startup money.
Freysworn Arborists are earthen located throughout Dornogal.
Freysworn Letitia is an earthen located in a cave at the base of Thul Medran on the Isle of Dorn. She is found with a stone giant stuck in the ground and a group of Pearlescent Shellcrabs.
Frillfish are fish found across the waters of the Dragon Isles, Quel'Thalas, and Harandar that resemble real-life lionfish.
Freysworn Mossbinders are earthen located at the Contender's Gate in Dornogal. They keep Kelpfist in check, allowing it to be used as a training dummy.
Freshly Fallen Sticks are sold by Nagar behind the Tradelounge in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal for .
Frijidar is an ice elemental found in a cave in the Ice Thistle Hills of . Shaman can free it from its imprisonment, after which it will attack.
Frog-Kissed Caviar drops from Shadowstarved Bullfrog in Hallowfall.
From the Depths They Come is located below the Fangs in Hallowfall, at the water's edge below the abandoned shack. __NOTOC__
From Many, One is a reputation achievement earned by reaching rank 25 with the Assembly of the Deeps.
Freysworn Etterca is an earthen freysworn located at the Crossroads Plaza on the Isle of Dorn.

Freysworn Cruton is an earthen freysworn located in Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn. He sent Woldtender Igris to Boskroot Basin in order to investigate why there hadn't been any word from Woldkeeper Freydrin in many cycles.
Fressa Blastfoot is a goblin located near the Grudge Grotto in Mmarl in eastern Azj-Kahet. She appears to be tinkering with her giant mechanical chicken, Zero Clucks Given.

Friendhaver Grem is an expert pet trainer located near the Warrens in the Ringing Deeps. He is surrounded by his three battle pets: Rufus, Bubs, and Takey-Take. Defeating him is required for the Battle on Khaz Algar achievement.

Freysworn Chalcy is an earthen located in the Rookery. She assisted Stormward Baelgrim and adventurers in defeating Stormguard Gorren, his skardyn followers, and the monstrosities they unleashed upon the Stormperch.
.]] The Freysworn are earthen designated by Freya with the responsibility of tending to the land and nurturing nature's gifts. They can be found among both the Oathsworn and the Unbound.
From Ashes to Wisdom concludes the fifth hidden local story of Guest Relations, started on 12 November and required for Assistant to the Assistant Guest Relations Manager.
Frightened Argali are argali located at the Stormsunder Crater in the Forbidden Reach.
Frizz B. is a goblin located at Shipping and Handling in the Undermine.

From Trash to Treasure is a delve achievement earned by collecting the cosmetic unlocks for the Delver's Gob-Trotter. During The War Within Season 2, this involved completing delves to earn Undercoin and progress the Delver's Journey reward track. After the season is over, the cosmetics have no requirements beyond their cost in Resonance Crystals.
Freywold Constable is an earthen located in Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn. She stopped Peacekeeper Leif and Lamplighter Kaerter when they arrived during their search for Shipwright Isaebela.
Freywold Protectors are a pair of earthen who accompanied a Freywold Constable to speak with Peacekeeper Leif and Lamplighter Kaerter in Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn.

Freydrin's Shillelagh is a staff that belonged to Woldkeeper Freydrin. It can be found near the back of her home in Boskroot Basin during Wold Memories and is then provided for Keeper's Aid and Boss of the Bosk.

Frilled Harbinger's Vestments is the Eternal Palace set for cloth-wearers. Several items for each armor slot can count towards collecting the appearance. Some drops from Wekemara in Nazjatar and a few pieces that can be crafted with Battle for Azeroth Tailoring can unlock the normal difficulty appearance. Completing the set grants the Under the Seams achievement.
